German and English semantic role families
europeDiscoveryLayers: reputable European job boards for discovery/cross-checking
newDiscoveryDuringAcceptance: Hochschule Furtwangen — Akademische/r Mitarbeiter/in Bereich medizinische Systemtechnik und Bilddatenverarbeitung; current and verified, but excluded because the vacancy requires very good German while candidate is B1; first professional experience is explicitly not required
coverage.verificationRule: Active recommendations require current evidence; stale/closed postings are excluded.
coverage.freshnessRule: Fresh means the exact vacancy fingerprint was not present in prior archived reports.
coverage.searchMethod: Fixed country + language + role-family + source matrix; broad discovery first; strict 0-years adjudication; CV-fit scoring; language/work-authorization assessment; official-source verification; vacancy-fingerprint deduplication; persistent rediscovery and false-negative hunt.
coverage.acceptanceAssessment: Architecture and publication controls passed. The live acceptance run verified the standardized protocol across Germany plus a broad European sample and confirmed that local-language searching surfaces additional opportunities such as the French EEG role and German HFU role. Full exhaustive all-country execution is a recurring production requirement; this single acceptance run is not claimed to have exhaustively enumerated every vacancy in every European country.
limitations: Search-engine indexing and country portals expose different levels of metadata
Some national portals require deeper manual navigation than the web index exposes
The acceptance run must not claim 100% vacancy recall; the persistent discovery/reverification layer is designed to reduce missed opportunities over repeated daily runs
Work authorization outside Germany remains role/country-specific unless explicitly stated by the employer
Several discovered opportunities were deliberately excluded because they required experience, had material CV/language gaps, or lacked sufficient current-status evidence
